assessment.applicability_basis: The source establishes that a synthetic false endorsement appeared in an Australian YouTube advertisement and was publicly rejected by the Premier and Consumer Protection Commissioner. It does not establish whether the AI output was used in the Union, whether a relevant provider or deployer placed or used the system in the Union, or where the responsible actors were established. It also does not establish the advertisement's reach or other facts needed to determine whether significant harm was reasonably likely. Those unresolved territorial and harm conditions prevent an occurrence-level applicability conclusion.
